title: Coldpass's Pass Gate is the first and only place that states plainly 'a companion's grief left unfinished [in a hold already passed] stays unfinished unless you walk back for it' — by the time a player reads this, companions' personal quests in holds off the main route (Vell's Hollowbrook ledger, Osk's Fenmarch family) may already be permanently unreachable, with no earlier warning at recruitment or at Act 2's opening that route choice forecloses them.
